clue.text: Deflect wide probing tennis stroke

clue.text: Finishes food each time before drink

clue.text: Especially on a training session, we hear casual shoe

clue.text: Hotel in capital of Norway

clue.text: Popular sci-fi writer peripherally scans Scottish city

clue.text: Country's prison with a district attorney

clue.text: Aussie native married within European Union
